title: PagingOfSecretAccessModel
description: Specify paging and sorting options for querying records and returning results

batchCount.description: Number of result batches available with current query options

hasNext.description: Whether there are any results in additional pages

hasPrev.description: Whether there are any results in previous pages

nextSkip.description: Correct value of 'skip' for the next page of results

pageCount.description: Number of result pages available with current query options

prevSkip.description: Correct value of 'skip' for the previous page of results

skip.description: Number of records to skip before taking results

take.description: Maximum number of records to include in results

accessRequestWorkflowMapId.description: The Id of the Access Request Workflow Map.

approverDisplayName.description: The Display Name of the Approver of the request

completed.description: Indicating if request has been completed

currentUserRestrictedFromReviewing.description: Indicating if current user is restricted from viewing the request

expirationDate.description: The Expiration Date of the request

folderId.description: The Folder Id of the Secret associated to the access request.

hasWorkflow.description: Indicating if request is associated to a Work Flow

requestingUserId.description: The Id of the User requesting access.

requestUsername.description: The Username of the User requesting access.

responseComment.description: The Comment of the response to the request

responseDate.description: The Date of the response to the request

reviewStatusMessage.description: The Review Status Message of the request

secretAccessRequestId.description: The Id of the Secret Access Request.

secretId.description: The Id of the Secret associated to the access request.

secretName.description: The Name of the Secret associated to the access request.

startDate.description: The Start Date of the request.

statusDescription.description: The Status Description of the request

ticketNumber.description: The Ticket Number of the request

ticketSystemId.description: The Ticket System Id of the request

Sort.description: Sort options. Multiple sort options can be provided in the query string.

priority.description: Priority index. Sorts with lower values are executed earlier
